summary.plain: About 600 physicists and engineers from roughly 60 institutions in 15 countries who built and ran the CDF particle detector at Fermilab from the 1980s until the Tevatron collider shut down in 2011, and who still analyze the data it recorded.
summary.technical: International collaboration operating the CDF general-purpose detector at the Fermilab Tevatron; per fnal.gov (2014), about 600 members from about 60 institutions in 15 countries, split roughly evenly between U.S. and non-U.S. participants.
